channel.title: The Hairy Bakers' Christmas Special
channel.desc: Christmas is coming, the geese are getting fat, and the Hairy Bakers are embarking on their first-ever Christmas special. On brand-new motorbikes, the Hairy Bakers travel round the country cooking up their favourite festive recipes as they plan an early Christmas party for families who won't be spending Christmas together: firefighters, nurses, police and ambulance crews.
